Leak Date: Sergio Giovanni Kitchens, born on June 14, 1993 in College Park, Georgia, started rapping in 2008 at the age of 15. He originally went by Yunggunn, pronounced "Yungin", which he would later change to "Yung Gunn" by 2010. He formed a rap group with Nechie, Boss Man D.E.Z., and others named SPC after the Shady Park Crips. In 2012, they release a mixtape hosted by DJ Scream, with features from Shortstop, Migo, Swisha, and Waka Flocka Flame.

Leak Date: YSL artist, Gunna, dropped his 2nd mixtape, Drip Season 2, on May 11, 2017. Drip Season 2 is the successor of Drip Season, Gunna’s first mixtape. Drip Season 2 is supported by big-star features from Playboi Carti, Offset, and Young Thug. Gunna featured on Young Thug’s “Floyd Mayweather” from his album JEFFERY. Young Thug also featured on Drip Season, as did Lil Duke another artist featured on Drip Season 2. The features on this mixtape would help push Gunna into a recognized state in the hip-hop community, which would later lead to the success of Drip Season 3. Drip Season 2 is supported by the singles “Phase”, “YSL”, “Beat Da Case”, and “Mayors”.

Leak Date: WUNNA is Atlanta rapper Gunna’s sophomore studio album, following his February 2019 release, Drip or Drown 2. The album’s title is named after a nickname of Gunna’s that he’s been called for years, “Gunna Wunna.” Gunna later turned the nickname into an acronym meaning “Wealthy Unapologetic N*gga Naturally Authentic” as promotion for the album. After being teased for months, the album’s lead single, “SKYBOX,” was released days later on March 6, with an exotic music video filmed in Morocco. The album’s second single and titular track, “WUNNA,” was released on May 18, 2020, four days prior to the album’s release. On May 20, Gunna revealed the album cover and tracklist on his Instagram.
